title: NIKO Journal Review 2026: Risk Check
description: Thinking of signing up with NIKO Journal? Its page offers cryptocurrencies trading and a $250 minimum but names no regulator or licence.

excerpt: "Journal" suggests a trading log tool, but the page sells crypto trading with wire transfers.
content:
"Journal" suggests a trading log tool, but the page sells crypto trading with wire transfers. It names no regulator, licence or operator. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: browser-based trading platform
  • Technology: AI technology
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: cryptocurrencies
  • Payment methods: local wire transfers
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal up to 24h
  • Registration fee: no registration fee
  • Support: all-day support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
